sentences.text: 2. When this case was listed before this Court on of 20.12.2023, the following order was passed:-
"Notice confined to respondents No. 1 to 3 at this rtstage.

The limited contention raised by learned Counsel for the petitioner in this case is that an application filed by the applicant under Section 3-H(iii) of the National Highway Act, 1956, is not being forwarded by the authorities to the Principal Civil Court of original jurisdiction,
which is adversely affecting the interest of the petitioner as she has a right in the acquired property and is entitled for the amount of compensation proportionate to her share in the property concerned.
Learned Additional Advocate General submits that he may be granted some time to have instructions in this regard.

Today, learned Additional Advocate General in compliance to abovesaid order has handed over a copy of instructions imparted by the competent Authority, Land Acquisition- cum- DM, Shahpur, H.P. dated 09.01.2024, which is ordered to be .
taken on record.

On the strength of said instructions, learned Additional Advocate General informs the Court that as there is a civil lis pending between the parties, i.e. appeal before the Court of learned Additional District Judge-II, Kangra at Dharamshala, of District Kangra, HP, it is for this reason that the application of the petitioner has not been forwarded by the competent authority to the rt statutory authority.
4. Taking into consideration this fact, this Court is of the considered view that interest of justice would be served, in case, these proceedings are closed but with the observation that as soon as the civil proceedings come to an end, the competent authority may deal with the application of the petitioner, in accordance with law.

entities.text: Additional District Judge-II, Kangra at Dharamshala
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petition stands disposed of in above terms.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, also stands disposed of.
